selection.ownership: Grafana Labs (Grafana Labs, Inc., New York, United States). The reviewed edition is Grafana Cloud HTTP API on *.grafana.net, not a mainland-China product and not self-hosted Grafana.

research.searchCoverage: Official Grafana HTTP API authentication (Bearer service account token), current-organization GET /api/org, data source list/get-by-uid, alerting provisioning alert-rules and contact-points, Grafana Cloud stack URL format on grafana.net, Grafana Labs US identity, and dated incident search for Grafana Labs / Grafana Cloud security breach/incident reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical GitHub-workflow (2025-04-26), Grafana Cloud Metrics Insights leak (2025-07-31), and TanStack/Shai-Hulud GitHub (2026-05) events are recorded; vendor reports Cloud production customer access was not obtained in the GitHub incidents and the Metrics leak was patched. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

exception.adoption: Historical incidents for non-China companies may proceed when contained and remediated; current unresolved issues remain held.
exception.usefulness: Grafana Cloud org, data source, and alerting-provisioning reads provide useful observability inventory without writes or App Platform version discovery.
exception.incident: Grafana Labs disclosed a 2025-07-31 Grafana Cloud Metrics memory-reuse leak in Insights UI (patched 2025-07-31 / scrubbed 2025-08-03), a 2025-04-26 GitHub Actions credential exposure with no production/customer-data access, and a 2026-05 TanStack/Shai-Hulud GitHub compromise limited to Grafana Labs GitHub (Cloud production not affected).
exception.remediation: Cloud Metrics distributor patched and malformed messages scrubbed; GitHub workflow credentials rotated and CI hardened; TanStack/Shai-Hulud tokens rotated with Mandiant review reporting no production repository poisoning.
exception.residualRisk: Self-hosted Grafana is not admitted. Live authentication and current Cloud security posture are unverified.

research.searchCoverage: Official Grafana HTTP API Bearer service-account authentication, GET /api/org, data-source and alerting-provisioning reads, Grafana Cloud *.grafana.net stack hosts, Grafana Labs (New York) identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical non-China incidents are recorded; no current unresolved Cloud platform compromise is asserted.

incidents.affectedData: Inactive CI credentials and a tools repository; vendor confirmed no code modification, production access, customer data, or personal information exposure.
incidents.remediation: Credentials rotated, TruffleHog added to CI, workflow hardening.
incidents.residualRisk: Historical CI credential exposure; production Grafana Cloud was not reported as accessed.

incidents.affectedData: Memory-reuse issue leaked malformed error content in Insights UI for a small subset of Cloud Metrics customers.
incidents.remediation: Mimir distributor patched 2025-07-31; malformed messages scrubbed from Grafana Cloud by 2025-08-03.
incidents.residualRisk: Early-adopter OSS Mimir RC builds needed a separate upgrade; Cloud leak is historical.

incidents.affectedProduct: Grafana Labs GitHub via TanStack npm / Mini Shai-Hulud
incidents.affectedData: Unauthorized GitHub repository access and codebase download; vendor and Mandiant reported no Cloud production compromise and no poisoning of production repositories delivered to end users.
incidents.status: confirmed historical GitHub supply-chain incident; Cloud production not affected
incidents.remediation: Tokens rotated; investigation closed 2026-05-27 with no customer production impact reported.
incidents.residualRisk: GitHub environment residual risk; Grafana Cloud HTTP API was not reported as accessed.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck uses official GET /api/org from the native validator; current-organization fetch is not a named upstream action, so the mapping reuses list_data_sources.
Caller-supplied baseUrl is replaced by required stored stack slug interpolated as https://{{stack}}.grafana.net with allowedHosts *.grafana.net (Algolia-style). Self-hosted Grafana is not admitted.
Native category is dev-tools rather than Data/Developer Tools: Rust CATEGORIES has no observability bucket.
Returns raw Grafana JSON array under data instead of the upstream {dataSources, raw} wrapper. Upstream user-agent is not sent.
uid is a URL-encoded path segment. Returns raw Grafana JSON under data instead of {dataSource}.
Returns raw Grafana JSON array under data instead of {alertRules}.
